Cherry Mash Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:12pm

Ingredients




1 cherry chip cake mix
4 eggs
1 can cherry pie filling
3 drops of pink food coloring
1 box chocolate fudge frosting mix
1 tablespoon peanut butter
1 cup chopped peanuts

Preparation

1 Beat eggs. Mix in the cake mix thoroughly. Stir in the pie filling. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes. cool before frosting. 2 Make frosting according to package directions and add the peanut butter and chopped peanuts. Cake may be baked in a 3 quart stainless steel mixing bowl with a small glass in center to resemble the candy bar. It will need to bake 45 to 50 minutes.
